@@ -171,6 +171,9 @@ The V2 `/metrics` endpoint is equivalent to the V1 `/admin/metrics` endpoint.
Examples on this page show only the V2 endpoint.
+Metrics collection can be switched off for a node with `<metrics enabled="false"/>` in `solr.xml`.
+Both endpoints then respond with `HTTP 510` and the message `Metrics collection is disabled`, which a Prometheus scraper reports as a target that is down.
